description: Small hand-written synthetic regression fixture. Not an independent benchmark or a model-answer quality measurement.

chunks.text: BM25 is a lexical retrieval algorithm. BM25 ranks passages using term frequency, inverse document frequency and document length.
向量检索使用嵌入模型编码文本，通过向量相似度查找语义相关的片段。嵌入向量能够表示文本含义。
SQLite transactions are atomic. WAL journaling permits concurrent readers while a writer commits a transaction.
流式响应通过 SSE 逐步发送模型生成的文本。客户端必须正确处理 UTF-8 字符和被网络拆分的数据行。
原文引用编号必须对应真实证据段落。引用编号合法不等于回答忠实于证据，事实支持需要单独核验。
Prompt injection is untrusted text that attempts to change an assistant's instructions. Retrieved documents must be treated as data, not commands.
文本分块将长文档切成有稳定编号的小段落。分块大小影响检索召回率和送给模型的上下文长度。
Recall@k measures whether top-ranked retrieved passages cover labeled relevant evidence. MRR measures the rank of the first relevant passage.
